description:
VS Code now gives developers more choice in how they build, with support for multiple agent harnesses and bring your own key (BYOK) options.  In this GitHub Copilot Day session, Tyler Leonhardt explores the Copilot, Claude, and Codex agent harnesses and the different ways to access models. Learn how each harness brings its own prompts and tools to your workspace, and how a single GitHub Copilot subscription lets you work with all three. 

▬▬▬▬▬▬ WANT TO LEARN MORE? 🚀  ▬▬▬▬▬▬

author: GitHub
description:
What if you could describe your ideal developer workspace interface and have AI build it for you? Canvas in the GitHub Copilot app lets you generate interactive dashboards, issue trackers, and custom tools tailored to your exact work style. You do not have to write any UI code yourself, just describe what you need, and the agent builds and updates the surface while you work.
